prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Create one refined wide landscape game environment concept, no panels no UI no labels. Merge reference 1's TERRAIN and SPATIAL STRUCTURE with reference 2's MOOD and COLOR, replacing ALL angry dolls with reference 3's affectionate SOFT PLUSH TOYS.
Reference 1 C: preserve lowland clearing, curving entrance from bottom right into level lower play space, large central tree/root island with roomy routes left and right, moss rock banks, cozy timber workshop cottage rear left. Emphasize NORTHERN REAR TERRAIN IS HIGHER: a modest elevated wooded terrace extends behind the whole clearing with a clearly visible mossy 2–3 meter bank, tree roots, rocks and upper footpath, cottage tucked at the FOOT of the northern bank. Lower clearing stays broad and level, not a mountainous pit; no stairs required in combat space. Camera fixed elevated 3/4 game view, not top down.
Reference 2 B: shaded dusky forest, deep desaturated blue-teal/navy foliage background, muted lavender shadows, pale lilac ribbons and fabric bunting loosely draped between trees, warmly glowing small amber lanterns and cozy golden cottage windows. Keep ground readable softly lit, no black crushed shadows; foreground and peripheral canopy darker than lower central play area, make warm pools small and precious. More shaded and lavender than C, not daylight yellowgreen. Ribbons are pale lavender solid soft fabric strips and delicate crochet swags, not excessive white cobwebs.
Reference 3: use only these NEW round huggable cloth dolls as sparse roadside props, all inanimate, palm-paw-up pretend "mew!" pose, pink cheeks, tiny rounded cat mouths and gentle dot/curved eyes, floppy lilac hoods or ghost blanket. One small ghost kitten doll hangs slightly crooked from a ribbon near entrance, one rounded hooded kitten pillow sits on a low side stump by cottage, one rests in a silk hammock. They look like cuddling baby cushions trying to scare someone, zero actual menace. NO angry eyebrows, slanted eyes, sharp teeth, zigzag grin, skulls, jackolanterns or distressed horror faces, do not copy any old doll in references 1/2. Keep these props much smaller than trees and away from fighting routes.
Cute cream/cocoa shortlegged chibi spiders: only 3 small living spiders at ground scale, one by a yarn basket, one in clearing, one near porch. One tiny whitehaired girl and three tiny black geese enter at lower right as scale only, not prominent. No giant spider or realistic spider swarm. A small cozy wood craft/book cottage at rear left, warm round window, books and thread spools on porch, partly nestled into bank. Sister spider character not depicted. Minimal ground web off to one side. Central trunk routes remain open.
STYLE: match references' polished cozy pixel-art storybook game environment, visible crisp pixel clusters and controlled texture, cute simple character silhouettes. Strong depth from dark foreground canopy to lower clearing to raised northern terrace, rich yet restrained lavender and warm amber palette. No text/watermark.
